# `rest-point` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "rest-point" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/rest-point/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | The kind of rest point, e.g. `campfire`. |
| `name` | string | required | Shown on the rest menu. |
| `needsFire` | boolean | `false` | Rest is refused unless the point is burning (the `burning` world property). |
| `fullRestHours` | number > 0 ≤ 24 | `8` | A rest this long gives the whole `restores` table; a shorter one a pro-rata share. |
| `restores` | object | `{"health":1,"stamina":1,"mana":1}` | Fraction of each pool’s maximum a full rest restores. |
| `restores.health` | number 0–1 | `1` |  |
| `restores.stamina` | number 0–1 | `1` |  |
| `restores.mana` | number 0–1 | `1` |  |
| `durations` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The durations the menu offers: until dawn, until dusk or a number of hours. |
| `durations[].kind` | `"dawn"` | required |  |
| `durations[].kind` | `"dusk"` | required |  |
| `durations[].kind` | `"hours"` | required |  |
| `durations[].hours` | integer 1–24 | required | Whole hours. |
| `interrupts` | list of object | `[]` | What can break a rest off early, rolled by chance per hour. |
| `interrupts[].id` | id | required | Names the interruption; the `rest.interrupted` event carries it. |
| `interrupts[].chancePerHour` | number 0–1 | required | Chance, rolled on the seeded `rest` stream once per game hour of the rest. |
| `interrupts[].message` | string | required | What the player is told when it happens. |
